evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a known production failure as something to reproduce carries low-arousal, mildly negative valence — weariness with a recurring defect rather than alarm about it.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Imperative 'must not' / 'must' clauses register urgency-as-demand — elevated arousal directed at preventing a negative outcome.
